title: A compatible pair of scheme points lifts to the fibre product
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ and $g:Y\to S$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. If $x\in X$ and $y\in Y$ satisfy $f(x)=g(y)$, there exists $z\in X\times_S Y$ whose two projections are $x$ and $y$ [def-pc-fibre-product].
